entry.title: Historical deep imports and current subpaths

content.snl: %Historical Toolkit integrations vendored parser source through a Git submodule. Such implementation paths are not public package exports. The current package exposes core, runtime, hover and entry subpaths as declared in package.json; it does not expose a parser-only subpath. An adapter migration requires checking its actual dependencies and the pinned public API, not assuming that a source file is a supported import.%
